# OakAttest: Hosted Security-Assessment Platform

OakAttest is a hosted, invite-based security-assessment platform for ASD-registered IRAP assessor firms, the managed service providers (MSPs) who run assessment practices, and the client organisations they assess. It runs the assessment lifecycle from organisation setup through scoping, evidence collection, fieldwork, findings, certification, residual risk, exportable artefacts, and ongoing compliance maintenance.

## Frameworks

OakAttest assesses against the framework that fits each engagement:
- Australian Government ISM: cumulative classification scoping, Essential Eight overlay, and Cloud IRAP provider-layer inheritance.
- NIST SP 800-53 (Rev 5): official OSCAL catalogue and baselines.
- SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria): the client imports their own licensed control set by CSV.
- ISO/IEC 27001 (Annex A): per-tenant control set scoped by Statement of Applicability.

A framework and revision are chosen per engagement. Australian classification and IRAP options appear only for the ISM; other frameworks scope by baseline or selection. Tenant-scoped catalogues keep client-licensed content private.

## For MSPs

One hosted instance supports many MSP partners, each managing many isolated client tenants. The platform owner provisions MSPs and invites their owners; MSP staff invite colleagues, provision client tenants with a plan, and drop into any client workspace to do the work, with an "acting in" indicator and a full context-switch audit trail.

## Collaboration

Internal discussion threads keep the assessor team and the client side separate, with @mentions that notify teammates. Users can watch an engagement to be notified when new evidence is uploaded or fields change. In-app notifications cover mentions, notes, and updates.

## Assessment lifecycle

Scoping (boundary, applicability, Statement of Applicability), evidence (requests, uploads, chain of custody), fieldwork (interviews, assessment notes, methods), findings (severity, remediation, sign-off), and certification (signed, defensible records).

## Hosting and trust

OakAttest is delivered as a managed service hosted by OakAttest with invite-based access. Deployments declare data residency (Australian by default), keep an append-only audit log, enforce row-level tenant isolation, and use role-based access control.

## Topics

- security assessment platform
- IRAP assessment software for Australia
- multi-framework compliance: ISM, NIST 800-53, SOC 2, ISO 27001
- MSP multi-tenant compliance platform
- evidence chain of custody and certification records
